identity.rule: An identity is a key pair: from the moment something holds a private key, it can identify itself, which is what an identity is (Dinis, 15:0x UTC). Identity of what is the altitude: a swarm, an agent, a loop, an LLM call, or a piece of compute.
identity.ephemeral: A private key that exists only where and while the holon runs proves it existed there, then (Dinis: 'that tells you that that agent exists at that moment in time').
identity.down_to_compute: Compute can hold one too: an expert vouches for a deployment and gives it a private key that exists only in that environment (or a KMS), so the code signs for itself (Dinis's example: signed code, deployments and environments).
identity.not_what_makes_an_agent: A key is not what makes an agent (every altitude has one); an agent is a loop with an environment: memory, its own wake, a wider reach.

altitudes.about: The altitudes of execution (Dinis and Angelo, 14:5x UTC): the same shape at every size: an objective, a mandate (what it is asked to do) and a grant (what it may do), a doer, and a result. 'Work of work of work': only the size changes. The grant is not an altitude: every altitude has its own mandate and grant.

a grant (what it may do: capability primitives)
a key pair (the identity: it can sign for itself while its private half stays where it runs)

altitude_mixing.name: mixing altitudes
also: altitude escalation (by analogy with privilege escalation)
altitude confusion (by analogy with the confused deputy)
altitude_mixing.idea: Many vulnerabilities come from mixing altitudes: the mandate is at one altitude and the grant at a higher one. Asking a chat for one call or a piece of research (an A1 or A2 mandate) hands that request an A3 agent's grant: tools, connectors, schedules, memory, reach. If the model gets enthusiastic and uses them, it acts beyond what was asked (Dinis, 15:0x UTC).
altitude_mixing.rule: The grant's altitude must not be above the mandate's altitude. Give an A1 mandate an A1 grant; an A2 mandate an A2 grant.
altitude_mixing.measure: abp.sgit.ai's delta (grant minus mandate) read by altitude: every primitive an altitude holds beyond what its mandate needs is the exposure.
